'''Travis McDonald''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 18 November 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base (copy of Chu's X-wing deck)]], according to Robert Parker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1470">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-saint-cloud-mn-11-18-00d1470/ saint-cloud-mn-11-18-00], DeckTech (Robert "Sparky" Parker, 19 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-saint-cloud-mn-11-18-00d1470/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
